title: Complete Portuguese (pt-BR) translation across all app screens

requirements.text: Replace all hardcoded UI strings across the app with i18n translation keys so that switching the language applies to every screen, tab, and conditional/empty state.

quotes: o app não está traduzindo as informações completamente, refaça os ajustes do botão para traduzir para todas as telas que abrir no app.
sim, busque traduzir o máximo que conseguir para o português

acceptanceCriteria: In ParentDashboard, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., titles, descriptions, tab labels, alert text, empty-state text).
In ChildHome, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., headings, descriptions, supervision notice, pairing warning, tab labels, card titles/descriptions).
In AdminPanel, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., headings, descriptions, tab labels, section titles/descriptions, empty-state text).
No user-visible English strings remain in the authenticated app flows when language is set to pt-BR (excluding user-generated content such as names and free-text notes).

requirements.text: Update the translation dictionaries to fully cover all UI text used by the app, ensuring pt-BR contains complete translations for every key and en remains the fallback for any missing key.

quotes: o app não está traduzindo as informações completamente, refaça os ajustes do botão para traduzir para todas as telas que abrir no app.
sim, busque traduzir o máximo que conseguir para o português

acceptanceCriteria: Any new translation keys introduced during the hardcoded-string removal are added to both frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts and frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts.
The app compiles with strong typing preserved for TranslationKey usage (no `any`-typed translation keys introduced).
When a key is missing in pt-BR, the UI falls back to the en value instead of displaying the raw key.

requirements.text: Ensure language switching works consistently for all currently mounted and newly rendered UI (e.g., when navigating between tabs, opening dialogs/modals, or when conditional sections appear) without requiring a refresh.

quotes: refaça os ajustes do botão para traduzir para todas as telas que abrir no app.

acceptanceCriteria: Changing the language from the LanguageSelector updates text immediately across the current page and any open modal/dialog (where applicable) without a full page reload.
After switching language, moving between tabs in ParentDashboard/ChildHome/AdminPanel shows the correct localized text in each tab’s content.
Language selection persists across reloads via the existing localStorage mechanism (appLanguage).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep the backend architecture unchanged (single Motoko actor); no backend changes are required for this translation task.
nonGoals: Translating user-generated content stored in the backend (e.g., profile names, free-form notes).
Adding new locales beyond en and pt-BR.
Changing the app’s feature set or implementing new backend APIs unrelated to localization.
